headline: On November 6, 2025: Canada culls 314 ostriches after H5N8 detection
captionCards: 314 ostriches were killed in one day
Set precedent for future animal disease control policies
instagramCaption:
Canada’s largest ostrich farm faces mass culling.

The CFIA ordered the killing of 314 ostriches in Edgewood, BC, after H5N8 was detected. Universal Ostrich Farm opposed the move, sparking a national controversy. The cull followed a confirmed case of avian flu in a single ostrich. This event highlighted tensions between biosecurity and animal welfare.

It remains a landmark case in Canada’s agricultural policy and pandemic response.
